name: 14222 · Buffalo, NY
findings: ZIP 14222 (Buffalo) has 93 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14222 (Buffalo) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
